description: Agent preflight: check an agent identity record before you deal with the agent. Input record as JSON (for example an ERC-8004 registration file or a passport excerpt: agent ID, name, endpoints or services, wallet, operator, registrations) or as text. The signed report marks each identity element present or missing and checks the record against itself: the agent ID against its registrations, one wallet across every field that names one, HTTPS endpoints on public host names, EIP-55 wallet checksums and CAIP-10 registry formats. POST /api/agent-identity-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no registry or chain lookup, no counterparty contact, and no payment signed, submitted or moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-preflight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/preflight/.

label.description: Optional name for the record, recorded in the report.

record.description: The agent identity record: JSON such as an ERC-8004 registration file or a passport excerpt (agent ID, name, endpoints or services, wallet, operator, registrations), or the same as text.
